verdict.rationale: Martin can place a scheduled phone call (wake-up call with weather/schedule), showing some voice interaction capability, but there is no evidence of an on-demand, natural two-way real-time voice conversation for general knowledge-worker tasks. Missing for 10: evidence of on-demand voice chat/conversation interface, evidence of natural back-and-forth dialogue beyond a scripted morning call, independent hands-on confirmation of voice quality/latency.
